description: This header file defines an API for interacting with the 'FlowStats' object of the 'Device.MoCA.Interface.QoS' TR-069 data model. It declares a singleton class 'MoCAInterfaceQoSFlowStats' with getter methods to retrieve various flow statistics like FlowID, Packet Destination Address, MaxRate, MaxBurstSize, LeaseTime, LeaseTimeLeft, and FlowPackets. The file also includes necessary headers, comments, and groupings related to TR-069 specification.

classes.name: MoCAInterfaceQoSFlowStats
classes.description: Singleton class providing getter methods for flow statistics related to the 'Device.MoCA.Interface.QoS.FlowStats' TR-069 object.

methods.name: get_FlowID
methods.description: Retrieves the FlowID used to identify a flow in the network, based on the mocaIfFlowID from MOCA11-MIB.

methods.name: get_PacketDA
methods.description: Retrieves the destination address (DA) for packets in this flow.

methods.name: get_MaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum required rate in Kbps for the flow.

methods.name: get_MaxBurstSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum burst size of the MoCA interface for the flow.

methods.name: get_LeaseTime
methods.description: Retrieves the lease time (in seconds) for the flow; 0 indicates unlimited.

methods.name: get_LeaseTimeLeft
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining lease time (in seconds) for the flow.

methods.name: get_FlowPackets
methods.description: Retrieves the number of packets transmitted for this flow.
